findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "legal?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: business_days, frcp_deadline, trust_three_way_reconciliation, contract_notice_dates, federal_prompt_pay_deadline, business_days_calculator, statute_limitations_date, citation_format_check, docket_days_rule, settlement_split · Private data: frcp_deadline, statute_limitations_date, hipaa_access_request_dates · Public sink: business_days, frcp_deadline, trust_three_way_reconciliation, contract_notice_dates, federal_prompt_pay_deadline, business_days_calculator, statute_limitations_date, citation_format_check, docket_days_rule, lien_deadline_dates, reg_e_error_resolution_dates, cobra_notice_dates, hipaa_access_request_dates, fcra_dispute_dates, settlement_split · Destructive: citation_format_check.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
